atlas-ee.0183: A first permit application gives no right to stay while you wait: if your visa or visa-free days run out first, you must leave. Only a renewal filed at least 2 months before expiry keeps you legal until the decision.
atlas-ee.0184: Your EU right of residence hangs on a registered address: move without re-registering within 30 days, or be struck off by the landlord, and it lapses.
atlas-ee.0185: Address registration needs a proper lease or the owner’s consent, from every co-owner; cash-in-hand landlords block it.
atlas-ee.0186: A first permit application gives no right to stay: if your visa-free days or visa run out before the decision, you must leave.
atlas-ee.0187: Public health cover starts 14 days after the employer registers you; keep the EHIC or private insurance until then.
atlas-ee.0188: e-Residency is a digital ID for running a company remotely: it gives no right to enter, live or work in Estonia.
atlas-ee.0189: Police appointments in Tallinn are much scarcer in August to October and January than the booking site suggests.
atlas-ee.0190: Some embassies ask students for far more money than the legal €220 a month.
atlas-ee.0191: Whether certified start-ups may pay just the minimum wage or must meet the scale-up threshold is still read differently by the police and Startup Estonia.
atlas-ee.0192: Restrictions on Russian and Belarusian citizens are renewed by decree and keep changing.
